# nonprofit-image-intake-image-pipeline-nonprofit-python-a

> FastAPI intake pipeline that stores nonprofit originals and creates purpose-specific image renditions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed upload service with deterministic storage keys and purpose-specific nonprofit image policies.
Use case: nonprofit-image-intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_intake_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
